address: 5F, Man Lap Fong, 9 Qingbo Road, Ersha Island, Yuexiu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Set in an iconic art-themed mall, this restaurant cleverly combines an artsy decor and expansive river views with a mix of traditional and modern Cantonese cuisine. Reserve a booth, or a table on the balcony to take in the vistas. Most dishes are based on the Lingnan healthy food culture; the dim sum lunch has a nice variety of small bites. The chargrilled Sakura pork belly boasts golden crackling skin and juicy, flavoursome meat....
